question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, all items, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for May 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-05-15) be above 2.38%, its value for March 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-04-15 (March 2025), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
